backseat.autoStart.description: Start polling automatically when VS Code starts (if the bridge repo is detected).

backseat.clineCommand.description: Command used to invoke the Cline CLI for the fallback path (full path if not on PATH).

backseat.defaultTimeoutSec.description: Kill a running task after this many seconds (unless the task sets timeout_sec).

backseat.heartbeatSec.description: How often to push a heartbeat status to the bridge repo while a task runs.

backseat.pollIntervalSec.description: How often to pull the bridge repo and look for pending tasks.

backseat.preferClineApi.description: Try driving the Cline VS Code extension via its API first; fall back to the Cline CLI when the API surface is unavailable.

backseat.repoPath.description: Local clone of the bridge repo. Leave empty: Backseat auto-detects it when you open the bridge repo folder in VS Code.

backseat.notifyTopic.description: ntfy.sh topic for instant task-finished pings (optional). When set, the extension POSTs a notification on every task completion and writes notify.json to the bridge repo so your Muse can discover it. Leave empty to disable; git polling still works.

description: Backseat-drive your Cline coding agent from your phone. Polls the bridge repo for architect tasks from Muse and runs them through Cline.
name: backseat
